main_text.p: I. Uterque est verus homo corpore terreno, anima rationali confians.
De ADAMO probetur ex creatione: Formavit hominem de limo: Inspiravit spiraculum vitæ. Faciamus hominem ad imaginem nostram, &c.
De CHRISTO I. ex Paulo, qui hominem appellat Rom.5.15.1.Cor.15.v.21.47.1.Tim.2.5.
Amplif. Et quidem verum hominem ex Adamo propagatum, quia semen, filius Abrahami, Davidis. Matth.1.1. Rom.1.3. & 9.5. Fructus ventris Mariæ. Luc.1.42. Filius hominis. Matth.9. Ioh.6.
2. quia oportebat fratrem nostrum esse & manere, ut pro nobis victima fieri, & nos sibi ta-quam membra capiti insitos gestare ac vivificare posset, Hebr.2. Ioh.15.
Rejiciantur breviter errores Marcionis, Apollinaris, Eutychetis, &c.
Christus omnes fideles electos. Ioh.7.6. Heb. 2.13.
III. Uterque meretur & communicat posteris suis, quod ipse habet.
Declaratur & probetur 1.Rom.5.14. Qui est typus futuri, &c. 1.Cor.15.v.48.49. Qualis terre-nus, &c.
2. quia uterque gignit posteros. Genitum autem habet naturam gignentis.
3. quia uterque accepit a Deo suis communi-canda.

page.notes: Doubtful: "confians" in line 1 may be read differently; the mark before "Fructus" is ignored as a stray printed sign. Line 1 of the Christus paragraph and the reference numbers are copied as printed. Ink and paper stains only; no other printed matter.
